newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman stocks gain over three pct in lively trade.
newsitem.headline: Oman stocks gain over three pct in lively trade.

text.p: Shares on the Oman stock exchange ploughed ahead in lively trade in the week to Wednesday, dominated once again by banking and investment stocks, the Muscat Securities Market said.
The stock market index climbed over three percent to end at 326.13 points from 315.51 a week earlier.
Total trade value soared to 14.1 million rials from 8.4 million the previous week. A total of 3.4 million shares changed hands, up from last week's 3.2 million.
Of the 73 stocks traded, 41 rose, 10 lost ground and 22 were unchanged.
Among the most active stocks this week was the National Bank of Oman, with 413,000 shares worth 3.5 million rials traded. The stock closed at 8.850 rials, up from 8.450 a week earlier.
Some 403,000 shares of Bank Muscat al Ahli al Omani worth 3.1 million rials changed hands. The share price rose to 8.230 rials after ending at 7.320 rials last week.
Gulf Investment Services Co closed at 5.480 rials, up from 4.880 rials last Wednesday.
Al-Shalman Securities rose 0.380 rials to end at 5.380.
Oman National Holding Co ended the week at 6.250 rials after last week's close of 5.920 rials.
Banking and investment shares accounted for 85 percent of trade, followed by industrials with nine percent, services with five percent and insurance stocks with one percent. ($1=0.377 rials)
